description.text: Activates Water Chain (max 150, field +50%), grants [Buff Water 10% (5s)]/[Buff Water 20% (5s)]/[Buff Water 30% (5s)] if 0-1/2-3/4+ allies have any [Attach Water], grants [ATK +50% (25s)], grants [Instant Cast 1] to the user

description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Water damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Water resistance +20%
